Chapter 865: Chapter 9 Sweep (Subscription Request)_2

Chapter 865: Chapter 9 Sweep (Subscription Request)_2

Xuanhuang Force Field, an innate ability of the Xuanhuang Physique, is used for defense against attacks.

But that doesn’t mean the Xuanhuang Force Field can’t attack proactively; it’s just that its attacking power is relatively weak.

However, the “weakness” here is only in relation to Lin Yuan. For those alien Eleventh Order beings present, it is undoubtedly a disaster.

Swoosh swoosh.

Xuanhuang-colored light erupted, sending heart-shaking waves through the battlefield. Countless Eleventh Order aliens fell one by one, collapsing into a massive rocky existence.

“My Insect Race Warriors…”

The Hive Mother Race watched in horror as her nurtured Insect Race Warriors vanished into ash under the Xuanhuang Force Field.

In no time, the Hive Mother Race’s own form began to crumble as well.

In a corner of the Xuanhuang Force Field.

Several Eleventh Order powerhouses of the Human Civilization Alliance stared dumbfounded at the one-sided massacre unfolding before them.

In their eyes, the novice Eleventh Order Galaxy Master, with every move he made, allowed nearly two hundred alien Eleventh Order beings to fall without a fight, including the Yu Race Mingche clad in supreme weaponry, barely clinging to life.

“Is the Galaxy Master’s strength this terrifying?”

Several Eleventh Order human powerhouses exchanged looks with each other, their minds trembling with fear.

They had thought earlier that the Galaxy Master was too arrogant, having already reached the Space-Time Path, and wondered why he didn’t just enter sooner. Instead, he chose to wait there for the Eleventh Order aliens to arrive.

Now, it seemed the Galaxy Master simply wanted to slaughter the Eleventh Order aliens for sport.

…

Before long.

Inside the Xuanhuang Force Field.

All the alien Eleventh Order beings had turned to dust and smoke.

Only the Yu Race Mingche remained, desperately defending himself with the Supreme Black Axe in his hand.

Though the Supreme Black Axe was not a defensive supreme weapon, its black luster provided a strong defense.

In fact, every supreme weapon has its myriad uses; an offensive supreme weapon can defend, and a defensive supreme weapon can attack, each differing only in the level of power they exhibit.

“Supreme weapons…”

Lin Yuan gazed at the black axe in the hand of Yu Race Mingche with a slightly somber expression.

Compared to the trivial transcendental power demonstrated by the peculiar objects within the Two-dimensional World, the formidable power of the Supreme Weapons in the Main Universe was truly frightening.

If Lin Yuan had not yet stepped into the Eleventh Order, he might indeed have had no way to contend with the opponent.

“Galaxy Master, spare me this one time. Name your conditions.”

Yu Race Mingche was genuinely scared and hurriedly spoke up.

Although he could temporarily hold his ground, he sensed that the mysterious force field around him was becoming heavier and more oppressive.

Most importantly, Mingche could no longer bear the energy expenditure of activating the Supreme Black Axe. On the contrary, Lin Yuan seemed to be handling it with ease.

Once Mingche could no longer wield the Supreme Black Axe, he would inevitably be crushed by the omnipresent mysterious force field surrounding him.

Without the Supreme Black Axe, Mingche would be no different from the massive rocky existences.

“Conditions, you’re asking me to provide?” Lin Yuan looked at him with a calm gaze, and smiled, “Surrender the Supreme Black Axe.”

“Give up the Supreme Black Axe?” Yu Race Mingche’s face soured, as the axe was loaned to him by his own Prison Tribe.

How would he explain this to the Prison Tribe if he handed it over to the Galaxy Master?

Compared to this Supreme Black Axe, what did his avatar amount to?

“Galaxy Master, please make another demand.” Yu Race Mingche said in a low voice.

If he had to choose between surrendering the Supreme Black Axe and continuing the standoff with the Galaxy Master, he would prefer the latter.

Perhaps before he ran out of energy, the Galaxy Master would give up?

Yu Race Mingche didn’t believe that the Galaxy Master could suppress a Supreme Weapon without any expenditure.

“Then I shall take it myself.” Lin Yuan said indifferently.

Boom boom boom.

The Xuanhuang-colored light around became increasingly intense.

After nearly half an hour, Yu Race Mingche could no longer hold on and, in a final act of desperation, activated the Supreme Black Axe aiming for a mutual destruction with Lin Yuan.

Unfortunately for him, the pitch-black, profound light from the axe was all blocked by Lin Yuan, and in the end, Yu Race Mingche perished, with the Supreme Black Axe quietly floating in the air.

Even without its master, the Supreme Weapon still emitted an ultimate tearing aura.

“The ultimate weapon…”

Lin Yuan’s mind willed it, and the black axe flew toward him, landing in his hand.

“It still has a master.”

Lin Yuan attempted to intrude the black axe with his mind will, but encountered resistance and immediately understood.

The Prison Tribe Mingche had only lost an avatar, not truly perished, hence the ultimate weapon wasn’t without an owner.

Nevertheless, Lin Yuan did not care. Once he brought the ultimate weapon back, naturally, there would be plenty of time to erode the internal resistance.

…

“My ultimate weapon…”

Within the Prison Tribe Territory, Mingche’s true self bellowed in madness.

For a powerhouse like him, at the eleventh tier, fifth category, an ultimate weapon was once in a lifetime.

If not for this massive battlefield’s creation, and the Prison Tribe’s urgent need for a significant number of powerhouses, he would have never had the chance to refine the ultimate weapon.

But now, everything was gone.

He not only failed to enter the core area of the battlefield, achieving nothing, but also lost the ultimate weapon.

“Why is that Galaxy Master’s strength so terrifying?” After a fit of rage, Mingche felt a chill in his heart.

Lin Yuan’s strength was too horrifying, and even if he had also relied on external forces, forcing him to exhaust his ultimate weapon to its last, was beyond anyone’s imagination.

“The Galaxy Master is definitely not a novice at the eleventh tier; he must have reached at least the Fifth Realm in his comprehension of space-time; otherwise it would not be possible to impose such a suppression on space-time that even I am unable to escape.”

Mingche took a deep breath.

“Too terrifying…”

Mingche felt a bit stifled, knowing earlier that the Galaxy Master had such power, he would have fled at the first opportunity.

…

In front of the Space-Time Path.

Lin Yuan glanced at the spoils of war.

The bodies of many alien eleventh-tiered beings were all turned into the most primal force by Lin Yuan’s ‘Primal Force’, then used as nourishment for cultivating his Xuanhuang Physique.

The bodies of those at the eleventh tier contained unimaginable amounts of energy, even for Lin Yuan, they were quite a boost.

Besides, Lin Yuan also gained an ultimate weapon, that black axe, as well as hundreds of various treasures.

“Waiting for half a day and this is the income, it’s quite worthwhile.”

A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face. Aside from the ultimate weapon and many treasures, just the essence energy contained within the one or two hundred alien eleventh-tier bodies, if converted into cosmic rare resources, would be measured in tens and hundreds of billions of Cosmic Crystals.

Not to mention an ultimate weapon of incalculable value.

Although Lin Yuan already had tens of ultimate weapons, nearly a hundred odd items garnered from the Two-dimensional World were mostly made of Twelve-Star rare materials.

But that certainly does not mean that the ultimate weapons are worthless.

“What are you all dawdling for?”

Lin Yuan glanced at the few eleventh-tier powerhouses of the Human Civilization Alliance standing in a corner, trembling with fear, afraid to speak.

From the beginning till now, Lin Yuan was using the Xuanhuang Force Field, secretly protecting these eleventh-tier powerhouses of the Human Civilization Alliance, to prevent them from being killed by the aftermath of the force field.

Although Lin Yuan was decisively lethal against eleventh-tier aliens, he was quite amiable towards his own people.

“Galaxy… Galaxy Master, what should we do now… what should we do now…”

The several eleventh-tier powerhouses of the Human Civilization Alliance finally mustered the courage to ask from the corner.

“Enter the Space-Time Path.”

Leaving this message behind, Lin Yuan stepped into the Space-Time Path’s entrance, and his figure disappeared from the spot.

“Let’s, let’s also go in,” After a while, the eleventh-tier powerhouses managed to come to their senses, approaching the Space-Time Path and looking towards the empty and desolate battlefield, couldn’t help but feel profound emotions.

“No wonder the supremes instructed us to follow the Galaxy Master’s lead upon entering the battlefield.” At this moment, these eleventh-tier powerhouses seemed to have an epiphany.

Originally, they were quite puzzled by this order and even though they dared not contradict the supremes, they could not help but speculate in their minds.

But now, they finally understood.

…

At the same time.

Within this border region…

The battle that took place…

To be precise, the massacre – the matter of numerous alien eleventh-tier beings being slaughtered by the Galaxy Master – swiftly spread among the top pinnacle race powers.
